newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FORECAST-Bank of China sees 5.8 pct HK 1997 growth.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Bank of China sees 5.8 pct HK 1997 growth.

text.p: The Bank of China's Hong Kong Macau Regional Office said on Thursday it has revised its forecast on Hong Kong's real gross domestic product (GDP) growth to 5.8 percent in 1997 from 5.5 percent.

"The handover of Hong Kong's sovereignty (to China) will maintain the factors that made Hong Kong success and at the same time put in new impetus to the economy," the economic research department said in a quarterly.
The office also revised its prediction on CPI(A), Hong Kong's broadest measure of inflation, to 6.5 percent rise from the previous forecast of 7.0 percent growth.
Hong Kong will revert to China on July 1 after more than 150 years of British colonial rule.
"The handover factor" would also boost Hong Kong's economy in the long term, the report said.
It forecast Hong Kong's GDP growth at 6.0 percent a year in the period 1998 to 2002 versus 5.4 percent for the preceding five year period.
